Core explanation · 00:00–04:59

In this session, we will take up problems of finding particular integral when the right hand side as capital X doesn't belong to any of the four standard forms we have discussed earlier.

Key details

  • It means when x is not a power ax, when x is not sine of a x plus b as well as of x plus b.
  • When x is not a polynomial case, when x is not e power x into v, where v is a function of x.
  • any one of these four forms.
  • D plus one times d plus two of y equals sine of v power x.
  • This is not any one of these four forms.
  • The particular integral is written as 1 divided by f of b which is nothing but d plus 1 times d plus 2 of capital X.
  • So we first resolve this into partial fraction.
  • Once we use partial fraction.
  • This expression reduces to one divided by d plus one minus one divided by d plus two.
  • It means a value becomes one, b becomes minus one.
  • Therefore, the particular integral is written as 1 divided by d plus 1 minus 1 divided by d plus 2 of this capital X.
  • Minus 1 by d plus 2 of sin of v power x.
  • We can take this as p2.
  • Finally, after computing p1 and p2, we go for p1 minus p2.
  • We know a standard formula that is 1 over p minus 1 of f of x equals e power ax integral e power minus ax into f of x to d x.
  • So when you apply this formula for this particular case we get a power minus x because area is minus 1.
  • Therefore a power minus a x becomes e power minus x.
  • A power minus ax becomes a power x, then sine of e power x times dx.
  • So we need to integrate this by substitution method.
  • Then this expression becomes integral psi t into dt.
  • Therefore, the value of P1 is going to be minus a power minus x of cos of e power x.
  • One over D plus two of sine of P power X.
  • Therefore, as per the standard formula, we get this particular step.
  • So when we use substitution method that is a power x equal to t, so that reduces to a power minus 2x integral.

  • It means let us learn how to find out particular integral when the right hand side x is not.
